templates.notes: Four years (6,800 hours) of practical experience. One month of full-time experience counts as 163 hours. Colorado sets no separate classroom-hour minimum; add your program's classroom target if it has one.

8,000 hours of supervised plumbing installation work while holding an active Idaho apprentice registration, plus 576 hours of instruction at a board-approved apprenticeship program. A work-experience-only pathway also exists.

At least 8,000 hours of on-the-job training before the written and manual journeyman exam. Louisiana Workforce Commission-registered apprenticeships can change the hours; confirm with your sponsor and add classroom hours if your program requires them.

templates.board: Board of State Examiners of Plumbers and Gas Fitters
templates.notes: 6,800 clock hours of practical work experience as a licensed apprentice and 550 clock hours of plumbing and gasfitting theory over at least four years (no more than 165 education hours credited per calendar year). 248 CMR 11.02.
At least 6,000 hours of experience gained over at least 3 years as an apprentice plumber under a master plumber. MCL 339.6115 sets no classroom-hour minimum.

templates.board: Minnesota Department of Labor and Industry
templates.notes: Four years of practical plumbing experience as a registered apprentice; one year counts as at least 1,750 hours (4 x 1,750 = 7,000). Minn. R. 4716.0020 also sets minimums for water distribution, DWV and fixture work.

3,850 hours of commercial and 3,850 hours of residential on-the-job experience, plus 576 hours of academic classroom training (OAR 918-695-0030). Tag your entries Commercial vs residential categories to track the split.

templates.board: Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners (TSBPE)
templates.notes: 8,000 hours under a Responsible Master Plumber while registered as a Plumber's Apprentice (or licensed Tradesman Plumber-Limited), plus the 48-hour TSBPE-approved training or a DOL-approved apprenticeship. A DOL-approved program can credit up to 1,000 OJT hours. Tradesman Plumber-Limited: 4,000 hours + 24-hour training.

Completion of a plumber's apprenticeship education program (576 classroom hours) and 8,000 hours of licensed plumbing experience under a licensed journeyman or master plumber. A 16,000-hour experience-only path also exists.

Four years or more (at least 8,000 hours) as a certified plumber trainee under a journey level plumber; at least 4,000 hours must be commercial or industrial. Hours only count while your trainee certificate is current.
